description: Reads a site's public robots.txt (crawl rules, sitemaps, AI-crawler rules) and security.txt (RFC 9116: contact, expiry, policy), and says whether security.txt is present, current or expired. Missing files are reported as absent, not as errors. Usually answers in a few seconds, up to 23 s on slower calls; allow a 45 s timeout. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
